g.text: Simulation, no patient data. Seed 42 (preregistered) · 200 replicates per cell, bars = Wilson 95 % interval · depth 44× · 400 het sites/chromosome · 3 affected chromosomes · A–C at 20 %, 1 200 sites each.

text.style: fill: #5b6670; font: 6.7px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif

g.text: D uses the ABSOLUTE statistic (variegated 0.055 → 0.000); its fall is a depth effect, not cancellation (EXP-015c, post-hoc). Power is optimistic: no GC, mappability or reference bias.

text.style: fill: #5b6670; font: 6.2px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: end
